__JSONABLE_value__.title: Architecture Knockout Plot
__JSONABLE_value__.description:
Relative change in correct-token prediction probability when removing information flow to the last token from various source tokens. 
The x-axis represents the relative depth of the first layer within the 9-layer attention knockout window, while the y-axis indicates the resulting performance change.

__JSONABLE_value__.title: Model Size Knockout Plot
__JSONABLE_value__.description:
Comparison of different model sizes within the same architecture family when removing information flow
to the last token from various source tokens.

__JSONABLE_value__.title: Window Size Knockout Plot
__JSONABLE_value__.description: Effect of different window sizes on the information flow from various source tokens to the last token.

__JSONABLE_value__.title: Heatmap Plot
__JSONABLE_value__.description: Heatmap visualization of information flow between tokens for specific prompts.

__JSONABLE_value__.title: Heatmaps Per sizes
__JSONABLE_value__.description:
Relative change in correct-token probability
after knocking out connection from each token to the last
token.
